item.text:
## Result

The supplied maps do not support a positive vmPFC gain effect after whole-brain correction: **none of the 23 corrected positive voxels overlapped the vmPFC localization envelope**. The envelope’s strongest voxel had whole-brain FWE *p* = .771; its mean effect was −0.0014 cope units (bootstrap 95% CI [−0.0152, 0.0127]). All corrected positive voxels were posterior.

I analyzed all 54 participants with a one-sided group *t* model and 5,000 sign-flip max-*T* permutations. No participants were excluded. These cope estimates reflect the upstream standardized gain modulator, not response change per dollar; participant-level variance maps were unavailable.
